caption: Vrijthof Christmas market, Maastricht
composition: Wooden chalets on Vrijthof, red Sint-Jan beside the grey Sint-Servaas westwork · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Magisch Maastricht fills the Vrijthof with peaked wooden chalets, a tall Christmas tree, and warm string lights. From the square the view runs left to right from the tall red Maas-Gothic tower of Sint-Janskerk, to the heavy grey Romanesque westwork of the Sint-Servaasbasiliek, to the small white columned Hoofdwacht. This is a seasonal artistic interpretation of a December 2026 evening in Europe/Amsterdam. It is not a December 2026 forecast. The Open-Meteo row is generation-time model data and is not the sky in the picture. The late-day square without the market remains NL-01-014. The south side and Bergportaal remain NL-01-049. No stall name is readable. No face is readable, and no person is the subject.
